name: m2e-course-download
title: Full-course download per pinned version
issue: Packages/QData: CourseDownloader that, for a course code and pinned version, uses CdnClient (m2b, hardened by m2b-followup) to fetch the manifest (SHA-256 verified against manifestSha256, already implemented in CdnClient) and then every artifact and content file the manifest lists, verifying each file's sha256 against the manifest before it is kept. Protocol-based: ContentFileStore (write atomically, hash-addressed, version-pinned directory; real FileManager impl plus in-memory fake), progress callback (done, discovered), bounded concurrency, cancellation, resumable (skip files already present with matching hash); a failed hash discards the file and fails the download without marking the version complete. Mark completeness only after all files verify. Audio is covered by the files the manifest lists; do not invent extra fetching.
